en.title: Where to Stay in Chongqing: Jiefangbei, Guanyinqiao or Shapingba?
en.headline: Choose a Chongqing Base by Terrain, Arrival and Evenings
en.description: Compare Jiefangbei, Guanyinqiao and Shapingba by vertical walking, transport handoffs, late evenings, day trips and luggage—not hotel rankings.
en.heroAlt: Jiefangbei pedestrian streets and towers illuminated at night in Chongqing.

zh.heroAlt: 夜间亮灯的重庆解放碑步行街与高楼。
